display_long_description:
Legends of Meridian is a casual, single player VR adventure.
Calloused hands pull your soggy body from the wreckage as the visage of your grandfather appears. You remember the salty sea captain who cursed his name just before your ship was wrecked. The search for your grandfather has led you to the legendary land of Loshae, and only with the mythical Oracle Jewels and the help of the inhabitants will you find a way to escape ... it won't be easy.


🏰You will have to explore the land of Loshae and discover its hidden secrets and artifacts that will unlock magic items and teleporters.

💣Practice will be required as you learn to sling shells and bombs quickly with deadly accuracy.

⛵️Wrenching boats through turbulent waters as you blast through the currents will ensure your survival.

🔫Mastering the hand cannon is paramount. Your coordination will be tested to the limits as you take care of Betty, the hand cannon, to ward off the perilous Tideblight.

🛡️A shield will help you in the moments while reloading.

🎣A fishing pole will ... well, it will help you fish.

🛁Also, there's something in the script about a hot tub. What's that about? I don't mean to break the fourth wall here, but I am very confused. Maybe it will come up in the game? This is immersion breaking, isn't it?

Forge bonds with the eccentric souls of Loshae, unearth ancient lore and battle your way back to reality as you experience the exhilarating adventure of the ... Legends of Meridian!
